verdict.rationale: Turso documents several ways to test without touching production. Branches are separate database instances created from an existing database, so changes don't affect the original, and branching can be automated per pull request (`turso db create --from-db`). Developers can also run a local database file or local libSQL server, dump production for local use, and provision isolated, token-scoped databases per agent, with tokens restricted by database and permission. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that branching and isolated sandboxes work as documented.
